top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a new organising principle for electronic matter, the time-reversal-protected Z2 invariant and quantum spin Hall state, with a short, decisive theory-to-experiment chain (Kane and Mele, then Molenkamp's observation of helical edge transport in HgTe wells) and almost two decades of stable confirmation across several probes and materials. It is distinct from the 2016 topology prize (time-reversal symmetry intact, no integer Hall conductance). Its weakness, the omitted Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang prediction and the 3D work, is real but is best handled by a citation scoped to the 2D effect. P002 is a clean, mature two-name invention but extends a metrology lineage already prized in 2005 and 2012 and has narrower conceptual reach; any prize is better than none.
